<!-- Code generated by packages/kit-compose/src/organisms.ts from packages/compose-gen/specs (compose-gen organism emitters on kit-compose). DO NOT EDIT. -->
<!--
  A top bar whose first item opens a wide panel of link groups, each with an icon and a list, and an optional
  promo card. The page keeps `open`; opening on hover or click is a port contract. Axes: panel (open, closed),
  cols (2, 3), promo (none, card).
-->
<script lang="ts">
import type { MegaGroup } from "./mega-menu.types";
import type { NavLink } from "./nav-bar.types";

export type MegaMenuProps = {
  label: string;
  brand: string;
  brandHref?: string;
  trigger: string;
  links: NavLink[];
  groups: MegaGroup[];
  promoTitle?: string;
  promoText?: string;
  panel?: "open" | "closed";
  cols?: "2" | "3";
  promo?: "none" | "card";
  landmarkLabel?: string;
};
</script>

<script setup lang="ts">
import Block from "../compose/Block.vue";
import Box from "../compose/Box.vue";
import ButtonPlain from "../compose/ButtonPlain.vue";
import Container from "../compose/Container.vue";
import Grid from "../compose/Grid.vue";
import Group from "../compose/Group.vue";
import List from "../compose/List.vue";
import ListItem from "../compose/ListItem.vue";
import LucideIcon from "../icons/LucideIcon.vue";
import Stack from "../compose/Stack.vue";
import Text from "../compose/Text.vue";
import MediaFrame from "../components/media-frame.vue";
import MenuEntry from "../components/menu-entry.vue";
import NavBlock from "../components/nav-block.vue";
import { cn, tpl, uniqLabel } from "../utils";

const {
  label,
  brand,
  brandHref,
  trigger,
  links,
  groups,
  promoTitle,
  promoText,
  panel = "open",
  cols = "3",
  promo = "none",
  landmarkLabel,
} = defineProps<MegaMenuProps>();
</script>

<template>
  <Block
    tag="header"
    class="relative border-b border-border bg-background"
    :aria-label="landmarkLabel"
    data-slot="mega-menu"
  >
    <Container
      :class="cn('mx-auto w-full max-w-6xl px-4', 'flex flex-wrap items-center gap-6 py-4')"
      data-slot="container"
    >
      <MenuEntry :href="brandHref" class="text-lg font-medium" testid="brand">
        {{ brand }}
      </MenuEntry>
      <NavBlock :label="(landmarkLabel ? uniqLabel(tpl('{0}, {1}', label, landmarkLabel)) : label)" class="flex-1">
        <Group gap="4" align="center" class="flex-wrap">
          <ButtonPlain
            type="button"
            class="inline-flex items-center gap-2 text-sm font-semibold"
            :aria-expanded="(((panel as string) === 'open') ? 'true' : 'false')"
            data-slot="mega-trigger"
          >
            {{ trigger }}
            <LucideIcon name="chevron-down" :size="16" />
          </ButtonPlain>
          <MenuEntry
            v-for="l in links"
            :key="l.id"
            :href="l.href"
            class="text-sm"
            :current="(l.id === '')"
            testid="nav-link"
          >
            {{ l.name }}
          </MenuEntry>
        </Group>
      </NavBlock>
    </Container>
  </Block>
  <Box v-if="((panel as string) === 'open')" class="border-t border-border bg-card" data-slot="mega-panel">
    <Container
      :class="cn(
        'mx-auto w-full max-w-6xl px-4',
        'grid gap-8 py-6',
        (((promo as string) === 'card') ? 'md:grid-cols-[1fr_16rem]' : '')
      )"
      data-slot="container"
    >
      <Grid
        v-if="((groups?.length ?? 0) > 0)"
        :cols="(((cols as string) === '2') ? '1-2' : '1-3')"
        class="gap-6"
        data-slot="items"
      >
        <Stack v-for="g in groups" :key="g.id" gap="2" data-slot="item">
          <Group gap="2" align="center">
            <LucideIcon :name="g.icon" :size="16" />
            <Text size="sm" weight="semibold">
              {{ g.title }}
            </Text>
          </Group>
          <List class="m-0 flex list-none flex-col gap-2 p-0">
            <ListItem v-for="item in g.links" :key="item.id" data-slot="links-row">
              <MenuEntry :href="item.href" class="text-sm text-muted-foreground">
                {{ item.name }}
              </MenuEntry>
            </ListItem>
          </List>
        </Stack>
      </Grid>
      <Stack
        v-if="((promo as string) === 'card')"
        gap="2"
        class="rounded bg-card inset-ring inset-ring-border p-4"
        data-slot="promo"
      >
        <MediaFrame :alt="(promoTitle ?? '')" ratio="4/3" />
        <Text size="base" weight="semibold">
          {{ promoTitle }}
        </Text>
        <Text size="xs" class="text-muted-foreground">
          {{ promoText }}
        </Text>
      </Stack>
    </Container>
  </Box>
</template>
